summary: L-4 cabin on Vulcan Peak in the Siskiyou National Forest, built 1941 and removed or destroyed in 1968. No source describes what remains on the summit today.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1968; no source describes what remains on the summit

access.note: Lies within the Kalmiopsis Wilderness; Oregon Hikers lists a hike to the old site; a 2021 forum thread titled as saying the peak is unaccessible is unverified, so check conditions before any visit

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1968 and firelookout.com says destroyed that year; Oregon Hikers gives only sometime in the 1960s. The story keeps the 1968 date and reports the disagreement over removal versus destruction.

notes_for_editor: The summit's current condition is undocumented beyond the 2002 fire. The Oregon Hikers page carries a 2021 forum thread titled as saying the lake and peak are unaccessible; it is unverified and was not used as a finding, but the story now mentions it as a reason to check conditions before any visit. The 1964 item is taken from the Forest Lookouts transcription and was not checked against The World. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced by public, based on the wilderness hike listing and no reported closure; the forum title is the only contrary note. The fact-check removed the story's visit advice (a walk into the wilderness) because no source supports the access it implies.
